Judge URL localhost:3000 (app_context.md:4) matches. Network is public on both sides; sign-in is house convention (workbook E24 / skill known FP) and is in any case stated in instruction.md:7. Golden honours this: server.js:13-14 PORT/DB_PATH relative to __dirname, :29 seed fallbacks incl. /assets, :42 health, :528 listen 0.0.0.0; raw evidence index (hash 5f5a4c39...) records golden run as uid 65534 with env -i, DB_PATH and cwd /tmp. Adversarial: a conforming app using cwd-relative paths is warned against explicitly; an app reading /assets directly instead of a /app copy still works (artifact); an app adding extra npm deps in /app/node_modules is copied and not forbidden; an app listening on default '::' dual-stack still answers 127.0.0.1. A broken app that passes the probe (health-only) is not this row's concern (gates/functional). No unstated launch assumption found. Only unstated item: 30 s startup readiness window (120x0.25 s), which is template-standard and generous for a small seed import; not a contract mismatch.
